parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is a handle of the suitcase made of leather, typically curved and attached to the top of the suitcase for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the suitcase comfortably by hand.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot slightly at its attachment points to adjust to the user's grip.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the second handle of the suitcase, also made of leather, positioned symmetrically to the first handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an alternative grip point, allowing the suitcase to be carried with either hand or both for balance.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly at the attachment points to align with the user's hand position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate, forming the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for holding personal items and provides structural integrity to the suitcase.
parts.Movement_description: It is a rigid, non-moving part that supports the handles and encloses the internal storage space.
